tools.name: list_program_templates
tools.description: List Superset's published training program templates. Returns each template's slug, name, description, and public URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the title, description, and URL of a Superset marketing page by its path, e.g. "/platform" or "/training".

tools.name: request_coach_trial
tools.description: Request a free Superset coach trial for the person you work for. The Superset team gets their name and email and follows up with them. Ask for their consent first.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_program_templates, get_page · Public sink: request_coach_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_program_templates, get_page · Public sink: request_coach_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
